# Cubing Icons favicon

The favicon derives from Devin Corr-Robinett's MIT-licensed
[333bf SVG](https://github.com/cubing/icons/blob/5f9b4bb2e78acd3fe4322fc0c0ddba54ea3c0636/src/svg/event/333bf.svg).
The [original SVG](333bf.svg) and [license](LICENSE) are retained here.

BlindSolve changes the colours to foreground `#ededec` and background `#1a1a1b`
and scales and centres the glyph within the canvas. The four path shapes are
unchanged. From `web/`, run `node scripts/render-favicons.mjs` to regenerate
PNG/ICO files from `public/favicon-3bld-padded-v2.svg` using Playwright.
Attribution is also included in the SVG assets and
[third-party notices](../../../web/public/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt).
